title: Reproducibility Artifact for Auditable Policy-Governed LLM-Agent Control for O-RAN Edge Security
description: Frozen reproducibility artifact for the IEEE TNSM manuscript "Auditable Policy-Governed LLM-Agent Control for O-RAN Edge Security." It contains the frozen synthetic-policy oracle, external LangGraph and open-weights baselines, prompt-injection experiment, analysis scripts, hash manifests, and manuscript-support evidence. The artifact does not claim production O-RAN actuation, completed independent human validation, or successful row-bound zero-knowledge verification across the retained 240-row matrix. Version 1.1.0 contains the TNSM-2026-12002 major-revision sources, three R1 PDFs, original recovered 180-run evidence, audit scripts, corrected oracle-relative metrics, retained-output replay, descriptive phase timing, and supervisor/reviewer alignment. Independent expert validation, a matched inference-time ablation and live O-RAN integration remain incomplete. This artifact supports a major revision.
